name: Artifact Signing
description: Sign all release artifacts with Sigstore. Signatures are published to Rekor transparency log.
purpose: Ensure every release artifact is cryptographically signed with Sigstore and the signature is publicly verifiable via Rekor, preventing tampering and enabling consumer-side verification.
acceptanceCriteria: All release artifacts (binaries, containers, archives) are signed with Sigstore (cosign).
Signatures are published to the Rekor transparency log automatically.
Signing is integrated into the release pipeline as a mandatory step.
Unsigned artifacts are never published to release channels.
Signature verification is tested in CI (cosign verify).
Keyless signing (OIDC-based) is used for all builds.
Signature format includes the digest, certificate, and Rekor bundle.
